name: ai-regression-platform
description: AI-powered automated regression testing framework monorepo.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @regression/shared && npm run build -w @regression/ai && npm run build -w @regression/runner
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @regression/api && npm run build -w @regression/web
